meaning.meaning: The SDK passed its BUS_STATE_ACTIVE precheck, then caught an Exception raised by bus.send. This is a generic SDK send failure code, not a Linux errno, an arm-controller error code, or proof of a particular physical failure.

exception_path.fact: SocketcanBus.send checks socket writability for the supplied timeout; expiry raises CanOperationError("Transmit buffer full") at line 800.
_send_once catches OSError and constructs CanOperationError("Failed to transmit: ...", error.errno) from the original error at lines 809–812.
CanError stores error_code and includes it in the exception string.

SendCanMessage checks BUS_STATE_ACTIVE, then calls self.bus.send. Its blanket except Exception as e at 207–208 returns SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED without logging e, preserving e, its errno, or exception type.

For command_timeout>0, transport is wrapped: bounded_send uses timeout=0.005 at line 192; checked_send raises RuntimeError containing only the returned enum at line 201. The original low-level exception has already been discarded by the SDK.

stop_chain.fact: joint_callback catches the propagated send error; logs Piper joint command failed at line 888; if command_timeout>0 invokes _stop_commands("joint command/send failed") at line 890.

_stop_commands latches _command_latched, clears application enable and command authority, publishes stopped execution state, then attempts MotionCtrl_1(0x01,0,0) quick-stop at line 722. It does not automatically reset/re-enable.
PublishExecutionState copies _command_latched into stop_latched at line 505 and publishes on execution_state_pub at line 532.
on_execution_state latches stop_latched with OR at line 491, withdraws execution authority and calls stop_base at line 498.
Subsequent execute/non-simulation cycles raise arm_stop_latched before proposing/delivering new commands.
reject calls stop_base; stop_base at lines 556–559 publishes a zero Twist when base_pub exists and does not publish a new stale arm target.

whole_body_effect: MPPI ceases new arm target delivery and publishes zero base Twist. This is not a measured all-joint zero-velocity command. The log also reports quick-stop send failure, so successful hardware quick-stop/physical motor disable cannot be concluded from this application latch alone.

preserved_and_missing_evidence.preserved: Generic SDK SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED status and driver stop reason/timestamp.
preserved_and_missing_evidence.not_preserved: Underlying Python exception type/message, Linux errno/error_code, exact failed arbitration ID in the driver wrapper error.
unproven_causes: 5ms writability timeout versus socket OSError versus another bus.send exception
Physical connector, power, emergency-stop state, bus load, kernel interface state, firmware behavior or runtime scheduling as the cause of the send exception

source_integrity.sdk_change_history_boundary: Current SDK bytes were read only; this case recording_start did not contain an SDK hash, so no independent SDK before/after assertion is made by this audit.
